Thanks —

Thanks for the clear summary. We can confirm Partner Registry activation is complete on our side for account 123-Redwood. For the webhook test URL, please POST to the staging endpoint we provisioned: https://mp-staging.amazon.com/hooks/rdw-123/test.

- Sample settlement/usage payload is in our guide; if you want, attach your sample and our infra team will validate mapping to the entitlement fields (SUBSCRIPTION_ID, USAGE_UNITS, USAGE_TIMESTAMP).

I’ve looped our marketplace support alias to pick an activation day. If Acme wants billing to begin on Dec 15 we can try to align (subject to contract effective date).

Daniel / Naomi —

Attached is a minimal example webhook payload and the lightweight HMAC validation snippet we normally share with partners (webhook-sample-payload.json). Key points for the integration:
- Use a single shared secret per AWS account to sign events. We recommend rotating quarterly.
- Map 'product_code' to the entitlement SKU so Acme’s internal billing correlates with the marketplace usage report.
- For latency safety, include a retry policy: 3 attempts with exponential backoff (1m, 5m, 20m). We push retries to the partner side, AWS will send async replays too.

If Acme can provide the endpoint and an IP allowlist window we’ll run a staged replay test on Dec 3.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Lead Integrations Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Lisa / Acme procurement —

Quick note from legal: we reviewed the redlines in agreement_redlines_v3.pdf. Two items that need a decision before activation:
1) Data retention: Acme asked for 90 days; AWS Marketplace terms default to 180 days for metering logs. We can accept 180 days in the marketplace listing and add a customer-side retention addendum in our SOW.
2) Billing disputes and liability cap: redlined to 6 months of fees — AWS prefers a 3-month reconciliation window for marketplace settlements. Can we meet in the middle at 4 months?

If Acme can confirm both points today we can push the DocuSign package for the effective date. I’ve attached a marked-up clause excerpt to expedite.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
